تواطأت (form VI)
# تَوَاطَأْتُ (tawāṭaʔtu) /ta.waː.tˤaʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَاطَأَ (tawāṭaʔa)
# تَوَاطَأْتَ (tawāṭaʔta) /ta.waː.tˤaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَاطَأَ (tawāṭaʔa)
# تَوَاطَأْتِ (tawāṭaʔti) /ta.waː.tˤaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَاطَأَ (tawāṭaʔa)
# تَوَاطَأَتْ (tawāṭaʔat) /ta.waː.tˤa.ʔat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
